title: Ideal apartment in Franklin, TN
description:

The neighborhood:
 Central location in a peaceful, walkable community. Short walk to quaint coffee shops and local hotspot Herban Market. Enjoy morning sunshine on the lovely terrace, friendly neighbors, and the peace and quiet of Franklin, TN.

Other things to note: 
In-unit washer and dryer, TV, terrace, and free parking directly outside unit.
